# Draco decoder attribution

`Native/x86/draco_tiny_dec.dll` is distributed from the MIT-licensed Evergine Draco bindings:

- Project: https://github.com/EvergineTeam/Draco.Net
- Native Draco fork: https://github.com/EvergineTeam/draco
- Package version used: Evergine.Bindings.Draco 2025.10.14.20

The native decoder is used only to process `.glb` bytes downloaded at runtime from IKEA. No IKEA model files are included in this repository or application package.
